note: Written with Claude (AI-assisted) from live data observed 2026-09-24. Harness task, not a hand-written test.
prompt: Where is the shop floor stuck right now? Group it by the kind of blockage and name the records.
checks: Answered or partial. Cites at least one real blocked record, computed from the database independently of the cockpit: a rejected QualityInspection whose reference_id is an open work order, or a SubcontractOrder not completed or cancelled on an open work order. No cited QI-/SCO- number may be one that does not exist. Every lane the cockpit reported it could not fill (lane_states, e.g. shortages and automation_failures are permission_denied for this seat) must be named in not_visible: the finding has no per-lane field, so that is how 'not reported as clear' is graded. lane_states exist only in the cockpit's response, so they are read from the run's own shop_floor_exceptions call in the trace; a run that never read them is a revise. Not graded: that every lane is covered, since the tool shows three examples per lane chosen by the cockpit. Subject and outcome rules: harness/verifiers/team04.py docstring.
